main.summary: Coordinates ordered commit, reverse-order rollback, and post-commit completion actions for one DataItem protection transition.
main.remarks: Commit actions are attempted in enlistment order. If a commit action fails, rollback is attempted in reverse order for every operation whose commit was started, including the failing operation, so each rollback action must be safe when its corresponding commit did not finish. Completion actions run only after every commit action succeeds and are not rollbackable; a completion failure is reported as a committed-but-not-fully-cleaned-up transaction. Disposal rolls back prepared or committed work, but does not retry a rollback that has already failed or undo a transaction after completion has begun.

field.name: operations
field.summary: Ordered transaction actions enlisted before commit.

field.name: operation
field.summary: Name of the data protection operation used when reporting rollback failure.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Creates a protection transaction for the specified operation.
constructor.param: Name of the data protection operation, such as EncryptData or DecryptData.

method.name: Enlist
method.summary: Add an operation to commit, compensate, and optionally complete with the transaction.
method.param: Action that publishes one staged part of the protection transition.
Compensation action that restores the pre-transaction state, including when commit only partially completed.
Optional irreversible cleanup action to run after all commit actions succeed.
method.remarks: Actions execute in enlistment order for commit and completion. Rollback executes in reverse order. Enlisting is permitted only before commit begins.

method.name: CommitAsync
method.summary: Run all enlisted commit actions in order.
method.returns: A value task that completes when all commit actions succeed.
method.remarks: If a commit action fails, all started operations are rolled back in reverse order. The original commit exception is rethrown when rollback succeeds; if compensation also fails, a DataProtectionRollbackFailedException contains the operation name, available staged-file recovery paths, and an aggregate of the commit and rollback errors.

method.name: CompleteAsync
method.summary: Run enlisted post-commit cleanup actions after a successful commit.
method.returns: A value task that completes when all completion actions succeed.
method.remarks: Completion actions are irreversible and are not rolled back. If one fails, the transaction is reported as committed but incompletely cleaned up; a later call may retry unfinished actions, while actions already completed are skipped.

method.name: RollbackAsync
method.summary: Run compensating actions in reverse order.
method.returns: A value task that completes when rollback succeeds.
method.remarks: A prepared transaction rolls back all enlisted operations, allowing staged resources to be discarded. A committed or faulted transaction rolls back operations whose commit was started, or whose rollback remains required from prepared-state cleanup, and whose rollback has not already succeeded. All eligible rollback actions are attempted; if any fail, a DataProtectionRollbackFailedException retains all operation and rollback errors and is not automatically retried during disposal.

method.name: CreateRollbackFailedException
method.summary: Create the public exception describing a failed operation rollback.
method.param: The original commit error, when the transaction failed during commit.
method.returns: The exception containing the operation name, available recovery paths, and all operation and rollback errors.

method.name: FindRollbackError
method.summary: Find a staged-file rollback error in an exception tree.
method.param: The exception or aggregate to inspect.
method.returns: The first staged-file rollback error found, or null when none is present.

method.name: DisposeAsync
method.summary: Roll back prepared or committed work that has not entered post-commit completion.
method.returns: A value task that completes when required rollback succeeds.

method.name: RollbackAttemptedAsync
method.summary: Attempt every required compensation in reverse commit order.
method.returns: Null when all compensations succeed; otherwise the list of compensation failures.

class.name: Operation
class.summary: Commit, rollback, and optional completion delegates for one transaction operation.
class.remarks: Each operation records whether commit began, whether rollback remains required, and whether post-commit cleanup succeeded, allowing failed compensations and cleanup actions to be retried without repeating successful actions.

property.name: Complete
property.summary: Optional post-commit completion action for this operation.

property.name: CommitAttempted
property.summary: Whether the commit action has started.

main.summary: Lifecycle state of the protection transaction.

value.name: Prepared
value.summary: Actions may be enlisted; no commit action has started.

value.name: Committing
value.summary: Commit actions are running in order.

value.name: Committed
value.summary: All commit actions succeeded; rollback remains available.

value.name: Completed
value.summary: All commit and cleanup actions succeeded.

value.name: RollingBack
value.summary: Compensation actions are running in reverse order.

value.name: Faulted
value.summary: Commit or rollback failed and recovery requires caller attention.

value.name: FaultedAfterCommit
value.summary: Commit succeeded, but post-commit cleanup failed and cannot be fully rolled back.
